t.*, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) ), 0) AS used_rule_count, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) AND r.enabled = 1), 0) AS enabled_used_rule_count, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.service_name, r.application_name, r.application_type) ), 0) AS used_application_count, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alarm_channel_binding b WHERE b.owner_type = 'TEMPLATE' AND b.owner_id = t.id), 0) AS channel_count
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alarm_template (service_name, name, description, updated_at) VALUES (#{serviceName}, #{name}, #{description}, UTC_TIMESTAMP())
mapper.update: UPDATE alarm_template SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE alarm_template SET deleted = 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM alarm_template t WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.deleted = 0
SELECT t.* FROM alarm_template t WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
